M.A.R.S. Companion

M.A.R.S. Companion is a fully offline AI voice companion developed by M.A.R.S. Companion LLC.

It is designed as a private, personal AI system that runs entirely locally on the user's hardware, without cloud dependency, mandatory accounts, subscriptions, or transmission of conversations to external servers.

Product

M.A.R.S. Companion is a Mobile Autonomous Reasoning System focused on private, local AI interaction and long-term semantic memory.

Core characteristics:

- 100% local AI processing
- Fully offline operation
- Long-term semantic conversational memory
- Context-aware reasoning
- Speech-to-text processing
- Speech synthesis
- No cloud dependency
- No mandatory account
- No subscription
- No conversational data harvesting
- Physical-button activation rather than a wake word
- Designed for private, personal use

Core Technology

M.A.R.S. uses a custom execution architecture called Sequential Resource Orchestration.

The architecture dynamically loads and unloads computationally intensive AI components in a controlled sequence. This is designed to make complex reasoning and long-term memory possible on constrained hardware.

The prototype has been tested on Raspberry Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM.

Privacy

Privacy is a fundamental design principle of M.A.R.S. Companion.

The system is designed so that voice conversations, memories, and AI processing remain on the user's device rather than being sent to cloud AI services.

The hardware architecture also incorporates device-specific encryption keys. Unauthorized access to protected storage is designed to make the stored data unreadable.

Prototype

A functional M.A.R.S. Companion prototype exists.

The prototype implements an offline pipeline including:

1. Speech-to-text
2. Semantic memory retrieval
3. Context-aware reasoning
4. Speech synthesis

The prototype has been tested by the founder and additional users.

Development Status

M.A.R.S. Companion is currently in the prototype and development stage.

The roadmap includes further hardware refinement, component sourcing, closed beta testing, and a limited hardware release.

Intellectual Property

M.A.R.S. Companion has pending UK patent applications.

Patent priority information published on the website includes GB2611463.7 with a priority date of 15 May 2026.

Company

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC is the company developing M.A.R.S. Companion.

The company was officially registered on 17 August 2026.

Founder

Aleksandr Sarkisian is the inventor and founder of M.A.R.S. Companion.
